summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: Package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases and then uses that downloaded binary to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB Bun-compiled bundle using string-array-shuffle obfuscation (rotator function, large shuffled string table, mangled `_0xNNNN` identifiers). The bundle bears no relation to a tslint folder-schema rule package and its behavior is not observable without executing it. The preinstall helper `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-suffix identifiers and function-alias indirection, which is inconsistent with a normal install helper. On `npm install`, this chain produces arbitrary code execution on the installer's host via a smuggled alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
